description: Read what jsDelivr, the free open-source CDN for npm packages and GitHub repositories, serves and how much. Look up a package's versions and tags, resolve a range such as ^5.2 to an exact version, list a version's files with their addresses and integrity values, find the file to load, or identify a file by its hash. Get the requests and bandwidth of a package, a version or a file, the most requested packages, and the network's traffic by CDN, country, browser and operating system. A trigger runs when a package gets a new version. No account or API key required.

jsdelivr_new_version_trigger.description: Runs when an npm package or GitHub repository gets a new version on jsDelivr: a new release of jquery, a new tag of twbs/bootstrap. Pre-releases count too; the run says which they are.
